suspects.name: Isabella Rossi
suspects.relationshipToVictim: Acquaintance (Victim was a harsh critic of her work)
suspects.personality: Passionate, volatile, feels wronged by the world.
suspects.physicalDescription: Fiery red hair often tied back, intense green eyes, hands calloused from sculpting, wears practical but stylish clothing.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was at Thorne's gallery, confronted him, and killed him in a fit of rage.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Was at home all evening, suffering from a severe migraine and unable to leave her apartment.
suspects.trueMotive: Revenge for Thorne's career-destroying reviews and public humiliation.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes agitated when discussing Thorne's reviews, avoids eye contact when asked about her whereabouts.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Knows Julian Vance is a rival collector and suspects he might have had dealings with Thorne. Believes Anya Petrova was Thorne's protégé and might know something.

suspects.name: Julian Vance
suspects.personality: Smooth, calculating, always looking for an angle.
suspects.physicalDescription: Impeccably dressed, silver hair slicked back, sharp features, a glint of ambition in his eyes.
suspects.trueAlibi: Visited Thorne's gallery earlier that evening to discuss a potential acquisition, but left before the murder occurred.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Spent the entire evening at his private gentlemen's club, the 'Elysian Lounge', playing cards.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was secretly negotiating to buy a piece Thorne had promised to another collector, a deal Thorne backed out of.
suspects.lyingTells: Slightly evasive when asked about his specific interactions with Thorne.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Views Isabella Rossi as an unstable artist. Knows Anya Petrova was Thorne's favored student and likely privy to his affairs.

suspects.name: Anya Petrova
suspects.personality: Quiet, observant, loyal, harbors resentment towards Thorne.
suspects.physicalDescription: Dark, often messy hair, wears simple, functional clothing, has paint smudges on her fingers, thoughtful expression.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was working late in her studio across town, restoring a valuable painting. She has a time-stamped receipt from a late-night coffee shop.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Was working late in her studio, as usual.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Knows Isabella Rossi had a public feud with Thorne. Suspects Julian Vance was trying to exploit Thorne financially.

suspects.name: Marcus Bellweather
suspects.personality: Gruff, observant, loyal to his job, but easily overlooked.
suspects.physicalDescription: Stocky build, receding hairline, tired eyes, wears a standard security uniform.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was on duty patrolling the building's perimeter and did not witness the murder itself, but saw Isabella Rossi leaving the gallery in a hurry around 9:15 PM.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Was making my rounds outside the gallery. Didn't see anyone enter or leave the main entrance after 8 PM.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was asleep in the security office for a period during the estimated time of the murder, and he saw Isabella Rossi leaving the gallery.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes defensive when asked about his patrol route and timing.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Saw Julian Vance visit Thorne earlier in the day. Knows Isabella Rossi has been increasingly agitated about Thorne's critiques.
